_about: François Guizot (1787-1874), historian and statesman, a philosopher of history: General History of Civilisation in Europe, from the Fall of the Roman Empire till the French Revolution, with A Treatise on Death Punishments (Edinburgh: W. and R. Chambers, 1848; translator not named); Democracy in France, January 1849, fourth edition (London: John Murray, 1849). Clean Gutenberg texts. Other Guizot titles stand on lane C and singles shelves (Popular History of France on robert-black; Representative Government and Washington on singles-history-2; Memoirs on singles-nonfiction-2; Meditations and Moral Sketches on singles-remainder). US public domain. No uids minted.
